description: Synthetic delivery dataset of one fictional lab's shared GPU allocation, job queue, results, evaluation protocols and results tables, seen from the researcher account of Nadia Ferrante, from 2025-01-01 to 2026-12-31T23:00:00-05:00. Every record is synthetic: the lab, the people, the cluster, the datasets, the configs and the results are fictional, and nothing was collected. A development script builds stories from fixed templates with a seeded PRNG and replays every step through the App's own hooks, so the App made every job of the researcher, every hold, sign-off, table, manifest and notification.

sources.description: Scripted synthetic lab history from story templates with seeded random variation; no external collection and no real person, lab, university, cluster, dataset, model or result. Dates are represented event dates of the fictional history, not collection dates.

generation.method: scripted replay of story templates with a seeded PRNG (mulberry32)

transformations: The seed keeps the notifications and activity rows of its current allocation period. Every record keeps its own history.

review.notes: Automated checks do not replace human review of realism, variation and reuse permissions.
